claude.performance_metric: net loss narrowed $178.5M (FY2020) to $142.4M (FY2021) on revenue decline $1,292.6M to $1,166.6M; no divestiture/impairment; going-concern doubt raised then resolved; 2022 Nasdaq bid-price notice
claude.rationale: The slice documents consolidated financial deterioration (declining revenue, sustained net losses, a temporarily disclosed going-concern doubt, and a 2022 Nasdaq minimum-bid-price notice) but does not attribute any of this to a product/process interface breakdown; the filing explicitly notes no source isolates the Novitex-derived product lines' post-close trajectory (recorded [UNVERIFIED]), so product/operations incoherence cannot be affirmed or ruled out (p4=uncertain). Similarly, the slice contains no realized-outcome evidence bearing on the operations-versus-organization/people/culture interface — no integration friction, management, or workforce disruption is documented — leaving p5 indeterminate (uncertain) rather than affirmatively absent. No documented evidence speaks to controlling-intent archetype incoherence or business-model incompatibility as played out, and the slice notes these dimensions are not addressed, so both are coded uncertain.

gemini.performance_metric: consolidated net loss narrowing from $178.5 million (FY2020) to $142.4 million (FY2021)
gemini.rationale: The slice provides no documented evidence of disruption at the product/process interface (p4_pathway) or fracture at the process/organization interface (p5_pathway). The company reported consolidated results and segments without detailing any specific integration failures or operational incoherence between the acquired businesses.

grok.performance_metric: no divestiture; net loss narrowed to $142.4M FY2021 on declining revenue
grok.rationale: The FY2021 10-K reports continued operation of the three SourceHOV-named segments (ITPS/HS/LLPS) with no discontinued-operations or divestiture of predecessor businesses, and no documented product-line/operations incoherence, so p4_pathway is 0. The same filing records consolidated losses, a reverse split, equity raise/debt reduction, and a Nasdaq bid-price notice but contains no evidence of operations-vs-organization/culture fracture over time, so p5_pathway is 0.
